Title: A rules question concerning Legion ?!?! - LSJ :O)

Messages.Author: d21...@yahoo.com.au
Messages.Body:
When I use Legion's effect to create a small vampire can can I use (has
memory failure), the special ability of the Harbringer to replace the
cards from my prey's library?

I'm at a bit of a loss, because some discussion with other players has
them thinking that you are able to do this?

Help me find a use for Legion :)

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:


No. Legion "discards" the rest of your hand. Agaitas lets you redraw
cards that you *play* from your prey's library. The point of the
Agaitas/Legion deck (which I still intend to make some day) is that you
play the other cards from your hand until your hand is filled with a) a
Discipline card, b) some crap that you can't use (most of which is
preferrably from your prey's library). Then you use Legion to get rid
of the crap and put a new vamp into play. It's somewhat ingenious, and
uses the disadvantage of Legion (having to discard your hand) to offset
the only disadvantage of using Agaitas (having stuff you can't use
gumming up your hand).
